title: Approve welcome composition
question: Peel Reveal is locked. Pick the composition to build — or combine / revise via steer. What should carry forward, and what feels false to Honest Clubhouse?

options.label: Stage-led peel
options.thesis: The Event hub peel owns the first viewport; welcome type rides the peeled corner; yellow Enter Events docks under the stage.
options.viewport: Sidebar + ~75% peel stage; copy on the sticker lip; CTA row below.
options.risk: Corner-riding type can fight readability if the peel angle is steep.

options.label: Title-led peel
options.thesis: Welcome + Enter Events lead the top third; the peel stage is the proof theater underneath with BEFORE/AFTER labels.
options.viewport: Headline band with inline CTA, then wide peel stage.
options.risk: Slightly closer to a straight layout — keep the peel oversized so it doesn’t feel like a feature card.

options.label: Immersive peel
options.thesis: Collapsed sidebar, full-bleed stage, floating welcome pill and Enter Events on the peel — maximum theater.
options.viewport: Icon rail + edge-to-edge stage with floating shell.
options.risk: Floating overlays can feel marketing-app, not Clubhouse operate shell.
